descriptions.value: llmware 0.4.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the collection-database layer (llmware/resources.py) where filter and lookup values are directly string-interpolated into SQL WHERE clauses without parameterization or escaping, in both the SQLite and PostgreSQL backends. The filter validator only checks keys against an allow-list and never sanitizes values. Attacker-controlled filter values reaching the public API via Library.block_lookup and Query.text_query_with_custom_filter / text_query_by_author_or_speaker can neutralize the intended filter to disclose rows the caller was scoped out of (cross-document/cross-collection disclosure); on PostgreSQL the flaw permits boolean- and UNION-based SQL injection.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
